name: 100% GOTS-Certified Organic Cotton Mittens
description:
Pokka Kids reversible mittens are a must have for infants and young toddlers that struggle with scratching. Made in the USA with four layers of 100% GOTS-certified organic cotton and AZO free dyes, these lightweight and breathable mittens feature: 
1) A French seam lining (AKA no raw edges) to eliminate irritations
2) A super soft fabric (which get more so with each wash!)
3) A fast drying material that helps prevent bacteria growth
4) Jacquard polka dots, which are woven into the fabric, not screen printed with harsh chemicals. 
Dimensions: Small 2 3/4 x 3 1/8 | Medium 3 x 3 1/2 | Large 3 3/8 x 4
